doc: A waterfront building's type (design/planner.md, Waterfronts), as a config entry: what it is, its colours, and what it keeps.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: What it is: a pier with moored boats, a boathouse over the water, a quay warehouse with a crane, or a fishery with its nets.

fields.name: boats
fields.doc: Boats moored at its largest size (fewer when smaller).
